text:
Every full-time employee gets 24 paid leave days per year, plus public holidays.
Unused days do not carry over past March 31st.

Sick leave is separate: up to 10 days per year with no approval needed, just a
message to your manager before 10 AM. For leaves longer than 3 days, HR needs a
doctor's note.

Leave requests go through the portal, and your manager approves them. Apply at
least two weeks ahead for planned vacations.

The main printer is on the 2nd floor next to the coffee machine. Its queue name
is FLOOR2-LASER.

Paper jams: open the front tray, pull the paper in the direction of printing,
never backwards. Toner warnings can be ignored for about 500 pages.

If a print job is stuck, cancel it from the queue on your own machine first.
Turning the printer off does not clear the queue - the job comes back.

The office network is called BlueOffice-5G. The guest network is BlueOffice-Guest
and its password rotates every Monday; the current one is printed on the
whiteboard in the kitchen.

If your laptop keeps dropping the connection, forget the network and rejoin it.
If that fails, the router in meeting room B reboots from the red switch on its
left side. Wait ninety seconds before reconnecting.
